title: Polonnaruwa: The Medieval Masterpiece
scope: Polonnaruwa as strategic provincial centre, later capital, relation to Mahaweli, Trincomalee and foreign exchange
limitations: Institutional synthesis; phrases assigning a 'key factor' to harbour proximity should be treated as interpretive weighting rather than exclusive causal proof.

title: Seruwila to Sri Pada (Sacred Foot Print Shrine), Ancient pilgrim route along the Mahaweli river in Sri Lanka
author_or_institution: UNESCO World Heritage Centre / Sri Lanka submission
scope: Mahaweli corridor, Polonnaruwa, Trincomalee/Koddiyar Bay and inland movement
limitations: Tentative-list dossier combines archaeology, chronicles and heritage interpretation; use for corridor geography, not as sole proof of medieval trade volumes.

title: Sri Lanka and the Silk Road of the Sea
author_or_institution: Senake Bandaranayake et al.; Sri Lanka National Commission for UNESCO / Central Cultural Fund
scope: Sri Lanka maritime history and museum sea-route synthesis
limitations: Accessible web preview confirms bibliographic identity but not the exact chronology or derivation of the museum panel's dhow/outrigger zone boundaries.

title: Sailing a Sinhalese Outrigger Logboat
author_or_institution: Gerald Grainge / International Journal of Nautical Archaeology
scope: documented Sri Lankan outrigger logboat tradition and cautions about reading classical texts as outrigger evidence
limitations: Modern traditional-craft study; does not date the introduction of outrigger technology to Sri Lanka.

title: Development of Outrigger Canoes in Sri Lanka - BOBP/WP/61
scope: traditional and modern Sri Lankan outrigger craft
limitations: Technical development paper; confirms tradition, not ancient chronology or the museum map's historical zone boundaries.
